description: Allowlist of US medtech and diabetes-device employers (v1 locked twelve plus post-v1 waves). hub_url is a public internships / university recruiting / early-careers page — not a login-only Workday search.

companies.name: Medtronic
companies.notes: Public Early Careers intern landing (internships, WISE, recruiting timeline, Apply for internships). Medtronic careers pages refer to the Workday Jobs Hub; do not use medtronic.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com as the hub URL. Adapter: config/scrapers/medtronic_scraper.py (JSON-LD JobPosting / intern job cards on the hub; hub remains if none). Catalog UA currently hits an Incorrect Browser wall. Do not use Workday CXS/search.

companies.name: Intuitive
companies.notes: Public Students & University intern/co-op landing with live intern reqs. Career site is careers.intuitive.com. Job board is SmartRecruiters (api.smartrecruiters.com/v1/companies/Intuitive/postings). Adapter: config/scrapers/intuitive_scraper.py (US STEM intern postings; hub remains if the board has none).

companies.name: Dexcom
